positive_snippets:
The hotel is somewhat New, so the rooms are quite nice and clean. But not soundproof, heard noises from other rooms.
One problem I faced was of water shortage, in the morning hotel ran out of water.
Power backup is there, don’t know how the food is. Caretaker is also nice and friendly.
Good rooms for a single day.Check on the hot water. Sometimes it comes very hot, some times the water is not hot.Switch is inside the bathroom.staff are very helpful

I had a comfortable stay at Hotel Charmwood Inn, Faridabad. The rooms were clean and well-equipped, and the staff was polite and helpful. The location is convenient, with easy access to nearby attractions. Great value for money—highly recommended for a budget stay.
